name: Pancake
description: A straddle-focused session that mixes active work with long passive holds, building toward folding your chest to the floor with legs wide.

items.cue: Soles together, sit tall and let the knees drop.
Rock slowly, knees wide, keep the back long.
Sink side to side, chest up, heel down on the bent leg.
Knees out over the toes, sit low and stay tall.
Tilt the pelvis forward, do not chase the toes with a round back.
Sit tall, hinge from the hips, kneecaps up.
Chest faces forward, reach up and over.
Small pulses, belly toward the floor, back long.
Relax into it. Sink a little on each exhale.
Let gravity open the legs, lower back stays down.
